ios.desc:
Healio helps you sleep better, build confidence, strengthen your faith, and create lasting positive habits through personalized affirmations, audio, journaling, and daily inspiration.

Whether you're struggling with anxiety, stress, low self-esteem, self-doubt, or negative thinking, Healio provides a calming space to reconnect with yourself and create healthier thought patterns.

### What's inside

• Thousands of positive affirmations for confidence, self-love, emotional healing, gratitude, abundance, relationships, and personal growth

• A unique library exploring more than **400 emotional and physical conditions**, helping you discover the emotional patterns connected to each one

• Guided affirmations designed to release emotional tension and support lasting inner change

• Beautiful animated backgrounds that create a calm and immersive experience

• Natural male and female voices for spoken affirmations

• Relaxing ambient soundscapes to help you unwind and focus

• Personalized daily reminders to build a consistent self-care habit

Whether you want to reduce stress, improve confidence, strengthen self-esteem, or simply cultivate a more positive mindset, Healio helps you create a healthier relationship with yourself—one affirmation at a time.

Start your healing journey today

Enjoy a 3-day free trial and experience the power of daily affirmations.

Cancel anytime.

quotes.text:
We're a duo maker and just shipped Healio v.2.0, an iOS self-help affirmations app.

we noticed most affirmation apps feel either too generic or too “woo”. we focused on short, emotionally grounded affirmations and a fast daily flow.

What’s different

Very short sessions (1–2 minutes)

Themes by emotional state (stress, guilt/shame, loneliness, resentment, etc.)

Save favorites + quick replay

Clean UI, minimal friction

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/healio-self-help-affirmations/id6667117173

If you try it, I’d love feedback!
